notes.title: Level Design Update
notes.notes:
[olist]
 Added glow particles.
 Butterflies fly by the level.
 The base of the labyrinth is now transparent.
 There are textures on the walls of the labyrinth.
[/olist]

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
To celebrate Halloween, we added a Halloween theme to the main screen.
 Added 5 levels
 Now you can see the location on the map

notes.title: First update
notes.notes:
During the first few days we received a lot of feedback about the game, thank you for showing such interest. 
We now have an updated game interface
Redesigned graphics
Added setting button in the main menu
You can now set the window mode and full screen play mode
Music volume control level

There will be more updates in the future, we already know where to go.
And closer to Halloween there will be an update dedicated to this holiday.

We look forward to receiving more feedback and suggestions, and I'll see you soon!
